data.narrative:
44.01 is a Series A climate and energy company that has raised $37M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of 9 comparable companies—1 public (Lnza) and 8 private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix—though narrow-filter peer matching proved insufficient for a reliable median valuation method.

The stage-progression method applies a 2.0x multiplier to the $37M total capital raised as a proxy for current valuation, implying $74M. This reflects typical step-up dynamics between Series A and subsequent rounds in the climate-tech sector. The peer-median approach was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Climate & Energy cohort; 8 same-sector peers exist, but none of the tighter valuation-tier filters yielded the 3+ datapoints needed for statistical credibility.

Based on stage-progression analysis alone, the triangulated range is $63M–$85M (low–high), with a midpoint of $74M. This single-method valuation carries material uncertainty around capital efficiency, technology maturity, and path to commercialization—variables not captured in simple stage-based multiples. A full peer-backed analysis would require either closer comparables at Series A in frontier energy or acceptance of wider-bracket sector medians at higher risk of irrelevance.
